clauses.evidence: Trace, [another creature you control (you_bear) attacks]: 'opp is dealt 3 damage (combat) (by you_bear/DEAL_DAMAGE)' (2 + 1); [on the opponent's turn, opp_bear attacks you]: none (no bonus). Packs E09_1 (+1 power: the unblocked attacker deals 3, a blocked one deals 3 to its blocker; the bonus is gone after combat), E09_2 (the opponent's attacker and my non-attacking blocker get no bonus) and E09_3 (power only: a 2/2 attacker blocked by a 2/2 first striker dies in the first-strike step and deals nothing, so its toughness is not raised). E09_4 (an attacker of a planeswalker gets the bonus too: it deals 3).
